biotools.summary: SAMI (Splicing Analysis with Molecular Indexes) is a pipeline for detecting aberrant splicing events in short-read RNA-seq data, focusing on identifying non-recurring events in low-dimension data. It is freely available as a Nextflow pipeline and Singularity container.
